strings.en:
I decided to leave. First decision I've made since waking up that brings me any sense of relief. Packed up my things and hit the road. Rata Sum, eat dolyak dung. Have fun cleaning out my closet (just give me credit for anything you find in there).  

I hitched a ride to Queensdale. Haven't been out here in a while... Hasn't changed a bit. Stayed in the same lodge Logan and I did every time we went to Lion's Arch. The smell is...poignant. Meat and cedar. Lots of sweat. They'd just finished a boar hunt when I arrived, so the whole venue is celebrating. What are they celebrating, you may ask? If I had to guess, just being alive. Not being stomped out by an Elder Dragon.  

Being around happy people is refreshing. Loud, though.  

Two years ago, I was sitting on my bed in the infirmary. I stared out the window all day, listening to the judgmental whispers outside my door... Now, I'm sitting in a tavern. Glass full of juice (ale doesn't agree with me these days). Joined by another asura, actually. A lady named Uenno; I feel like I know the name, but I can't recall if we've ever crossed paths before.

"Did you see the size of that thing?"
—Travis

strings.en:
%str1%. On behalf of the Shining Blade, I humbly request your assistance with a large-scale investigation.

After the widespread destruction in the Bloodstone Fen region, a number of events of critical interest to the Krytan throne have occurred, chief among them the unmasking of the White Mantle, the return of the Unseen—thought to be extinct—who once controlled Kryta, and revelations concerning the god Balthazar.

To ensure that these events are fully put to rest, Lady Anise has instructed me to gather any and all recollections and detailed accounts from persons of importance surrounding the crisis. For the continued security of Kryta, we must be confident that it cannot once more be brought to the brink.

Your aid in this will, of course, be paramount. I will await your favorable reply near the Minister's Waypoint in Divinity's Reach.

—Lady Valette

I am Skarti, son of Knut Whitebear.

You're not inexperienced when it comes to facing unknown threats. None of us are anymore; not really. When those demons arrived, they brought something even the Elder Dragons couldn't get to last for longer than a bonfire on a cold night: peace. Or at least, conversations about peace.

You've been invited to the Tyrian Alliance. I'll give you the details. Meet with me in Hoelbrak and we'll get to it.
